author: Shirley Escobedo
title: Brownsville ISD Superintendent announces retirement plans - NewsBreak
text:
By Shirley Escobedo ,
56 minutes ago
BROWNSVILLE, Texas ( ValleyCentral ) — During Tuesday’s Brownsville Independent School District board meeting, Superintendent Jesus H. Chavez announced he is not seeking a new contract.
After voting to approve the minutes during the meeting, Superintendent Chavez presented his retirement as “introductory comments”.
He expressed his sincere gratitude to the people who have supported the schools and community throughout his tenure.
“I signed a one-year contract that goes into a second year; this is my second year. I am not seeking a new contract. I will be concluding my service with BISD at the end of this school year,” Superintendent Chavez said. “I will continue to serve as superintendent throughout the end of my contract, June 30, 2026, and remain fully committed to supporting the district during this transition.”
Superintendent Chavez said he was proud of being from Brownsville and thanked everyone for their trust and support.
“We are truly thankful to Dr. Chavez for coming out of retirement to lead BISD, the largest district in the Valley, through challenging times like school closures and other major events, ” said Vanessa Borrego, president of the Association of Brownsville Educators, in a statement. “His professionalism and leadership have been invaluable, and we deeply appreciate all the advancements made during his tenure.”
